units.en: Shi Wenqing and Shen Keqing won favor through flattery, monopolized power, and Zai grew still more distant.
units.literal: It happened that Shi Wenqing and Shen Keqing through fawning and favoritism were close and cherished, monopolizing the balance of power, while Zai grew still more distant.

units.zh: 文慶等因共譖縡受高驪使金，後主收縡下獄。
units.en: Wenqing and the others then slandered Zai for taking gold from a Goguryeo envoy; Houzhu had him arrested and imprisoned.
units.literal: Wenqing and the others therefore together slandered Zai for receiving gold from a Goguryeo envoy; Houzhu arrested Zai and put him in prison.

units.zh: 縡素剛，因憤恚，乃於獄中上書曰：「夫君人者，恭事上帝，子愛下民，省嗜慾，遠諂佞，未明求衣，日旰忘食，是以澤被區宇，慶流子孫。
units.en: Zai was by nature unyielding; in rage he submitted a memorial from prison: "A ruler should respectfully serve Heaven, love the people, curb desire, keep far from flatterers, rise at unclear dawn and forget food at sundown—then grace covers the realm and blessing reaches his heirs.
units.literal: Zai by nature was firm; in indignant rage he thereupon submitted a memorial from prison, saying: "The ruler ought to respectfully serve the Supreme Lord, love and cherish the people below, reduce cravings and desires, keep far from flattery and favoritism, at unclear dawn seek clothing, at sundown forget food—thereby grace covers the realm and blessing flows to sons and grandsons.

units.zh: 陛下頃來酒色過度，不虔郊廟之神，專媚淫昏之鬼；
units.en: Your Majesty of late has gone to excess in wine and sex, neglects the spirits of the suburban altars, and dotes only on ghosts of lewd darkness;
units.literal: Your Majesty of late has passed bounds in wine and sex, is not reverent toward the spirits of the suburban altars, and dotes on the ghosts of lewd darkness alone;

units.zh: 小人在側，宦豎弄權，惡忠直若仇讎，視生民如草芥；
units.en: petty men stand at your side, eunuchs toy with power, you hate the loyal and upright as enemies, and treat the people like grass;
units.literal: petty men are at your side, palace eunuchs toy with power, you hate the loyal and straight as enemies, and regard living people as grass and stubble;

units.zh: 後宮曳綺繡，廄馬餘菽粟，百姓流離，殭尸蔽野；
units.en: the rear palace trails brocade while stable horses leave grain unused, the people wander homeless, and stiff corpses cover the wilds;
units.literal: in the rear palace trailing brocade and embroidery, in the stables horses leave grain and millet surplus, while the people wander displaced and stiff corpses cover the wilds;

units.zh: 貨賄公行，帑藏損耗，神怒民怨，眾叛親離。
units.en: bribes run openly, the treasury drains, spirits rage and the people resent, the masses rebel and kin turn away.
units.literal: bribes go openly, the treasury is drained, the spirits are angry and the people resentful, the masses rebel and kin turn away.

units.zh: 恐東南王氣，自斯而盡。」
units.en: I fear the kingly qi of the southeast ends here."
units.literal: I fear the kingly qi of the southeast ends from this."

units.zh: 書奏，後主大怒。
units.en: When the memorial arrived Houzhu was furious.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted Houzhu was greatly enraged.

units.zh: 頃之，意稍解，遣使謂縡曰：「我欲赦卿，卿能改過不？」
units.en: Before long his anger cooled somewhat; he sent an envoy to tell Zai, "I wish to pardon you—can you reform your faults?"
units.literal: Before long his mind eased somewhat; he sent an envoy to tell Zai: "I wish to pardon you—can you reform your faults?"

units.zh: 縡對曰：「臣心如面，臣面可改，則臣心可改。」
units.en: Zai replied, "My mind is like my face; if my face can change, then my mind can change."
units.literal: Zai replied: "My mind is like my face; if my face can change, then my mind can change."

units.zh: 後主於是益怒，令宦者李善慶窮治其事，[7]遂賜死獄中，時年五十五。
units.en: Houzhu then grew still angrier and ordered the eunuch Li Shanqing to investigate to the end, [7] and Zai was ordered to die in prison, aged fifty-five.
units.literal: Houzhu thereupon grew still more angry and ordered the eunuch Li Shanqing to investigate the matter to the end, [7] and Zai was granted death in prison, aged fifty-five.

units.zh: 有集十卷行於世。
units.en: A collection of writings in ten scrolls circulated after his death.
units.literal: He had a collection of writings in ten scrolls circulating in the world.

units.zh: 時有吳興章華，字仲宗，家世農夫，至華獨好學，與士君子遊處，頗覽經史，善屬文。
units.en: At the time Zhang Hua of Wuxing, styled Zhongzong, came from a farming family—he alone loved learning, kept company with scholars, read widely in the classics and histories, and wrote well.
units.literal: At the time there was Zhang Hua of Wuxing, styled Zhongzong; his family for generations were farmers—Hua alone loved learning, associated with gentlemen and scholars, and broadly read the classics and histories, skilled at composition.

units.zh: 侯景之亂，乃遊嶺南，居羅浮山寺，專精習業。
units.en: During Hou Jing's turmoil he fled to Lingnan, lived at Luofu Mountain Temple, and devoted himself to study.
units.literal: In the turmoil of Hou Jing he then traveled to Lingnan, lived at Luofu Mountain Temple, and devoted himself to study.

units.zh: 歐陽頠為廣州刺史，署為南海太守。
units.en: Ouyang Wei, inspector of Guangzhou, appointed him administrator of Nanhai.
units.literal: Ouyang Wei was inspector of Guangzhou and appointed him Administrator of Nanhai.

units.zh: 及歐陽紇敗，乃還京師。
units.en: When Ouyang He was defeated he returned to the capital.
units.literal: When Ouyang He was defeated he then returned to the capital.

units.zh: 太建中，高宗使吏部侍郎蕭引喻廣州刺史馬靖，令入子為質，引奏華與俱行。
units.en: In the Taijian era, Emperor Xuan sent vice minister of personnel Xiao Yin to instruct Guangzhou inspector Ma Jing to send his son as hostage; Yin memorialized that Hua should accompany the mission.
units.literal: In the Taijian era, Emperor Xuan sent vice minister of personnel Xiao Yin to instruct Guangzhou inspector Ma Jing to send in his son as hostage; Yin memorialized that Hua should accompany him.

units.zh: 使還，而高宗崩。
units.en: When the mission returned, Emperor Xuan had died.
units.literal: When the mission returned, Emperor Xuan had died.

units.zh: 後主即位，朝臣以華素無伐閱，競排詆之，乃除大市令，既雅非所好，乃辭以疾，鬱鬱不得志。
units.en: When Houzhu took the throne, court gentlemen—Hua had no record of merit—competed to slander him; he was made director of the great market. That post ill suited him; he pleaded illness and resigned, depressed and thwarted.
units.literal: When Houzhu took the throne the court gentlemen, because Hua by nature had no meritorious background, all competed to slander him; he was therefore made director of the great market. As it was utterly not to his liking, he pleaded illness and resigned, depressed and without achieving his aim.

units.zh: 禎明初，上書極諫，其大略曰：「昔高祖南平百越，北誅逆虜；
units.en: Early in Zhenming he submitted a memorial of fierce remonstrance, saying in gist: "In the past the Founder pacified the Hundred Yue in the south and punished the rebel captives in the north;
units.literal: Early in Zhenming he submitted a memorial of extreme remonstrance; its general purport said: "In the past the Founder southward pacified the Hundred Yue and northward punished the rebellious captives;

units.zh: 世祖東定吳會，西破王琳；
units.en: Emperor Wen eastward settled Wu and Kuaiji and westward broke Wang Lin;
units.literal: Emperor Wen eastward settled Wu and Kuaiji and westward broke Wang Lin;

units.zh: 高宗克復淮南，辟地千里：三祖之功，亦至勤矣。
units.en: Emperor Xuan recovered Huainan and opened land for a thousand li—the merit of the three ancestors was utmost diligence.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan recovered Huainan and opened land for a thousand li—the merit of the three ancestors was also utmost diligence.

units.zh: 陛下即位，于今五年，不思先帝之艱難，不知天命之可畏，溺於嬖寵，惑於酒色，祠七廟而不出，拜妃嬪而臨軒，老臣宿將，棄之草莽，諂佞讒邪，昇之朝廷。
units.en: Your Majesty has reigned five years without remembering the former emperor's hardships or fearing Heaven's mandate, drowning in favorites and delusion of wine and sex, sacrificing at the seven temples yet not going out, bowing to consorts yet holding court, casting old ministers and veteran generals to the wilds and raising flatterers and slanderers.
units.literal: Your Majesty has reigned now five years, not thinking of the former emperor's hardships, not knowing that Heaven's mandate is to be feared, drowning in favorites, deluded by wine and sex, sacrificing at the seven temples yet not going out, bowing to consorts yet holding court, old ministers and veteran generals cast to the wild grass, flatterers and slanderous villains raised into the court.

units.zh: 今疆埸日蹙，隋軍壓境，陛下如不改絃易張，臣見麋鹿復遊於姑蘇臺矣。」
units.en: Now the frontier shrinks daily and Sui troops press the border—if Your Majesty does not change course, I see deer roaming the Gusu Terrace again."
units.literal: Now the frontier daily narrows and Sui troops press the border—if Your Majesty does not change the string and ease the bow, I see deer again roaming the Gusu Terrace."

units.zh: 書奏，後主大怒，即日命斬之。
units.en: When the memorial arrived Houzhu was furious and ordered him beheaded that same day.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted Houzhu was greatly enraged and that same day ordered him beheaded.

units.zh: 史臣曰：蕭濟、陸瓊，俱以才學顯著，顧野王博極群典，傅縡聰警特達，並一代之英靈矣。
units.en: The historiographer says: Xiao Ji and Lu Qiong both shone for talent and learning; Gu Yewang mastered the canon; Fu Zai was brilliantly sharp—all spirits of an age.
units.literal: The historiographer says: Xiao Ji and Lu Qiong both for talent and learning were illustrious; Gu Yewang's learning exhausted the canon; Fu Zai was sharp-witted and outstanding—all spirits of an age.

units.zh: 然縡不能循道進退，遂寘極網，悲夫！
units.en: Yet Zai could not advance and withdraw by the Way and so fell into the utmost net—pitiable!
units.literal: Yet Zai could not follow the Way in advancing and withdrawing and therefore fell into the utmost net—pitiable!

units.zh: 庚寅，以驃騎將軍、司空、揚州刺史、新除尚書令安成王頊為驃騎大將軍，進位司徒、錄尚書、都督中外諸軍事。
units.en: On gengyin day Xu, Prince of Ancheng—cavalry general, minister of works, inspector of Yangzhou, and newly appointed director of the Masters of Writing—was made grand general of agile cavalry, promoted to minister over the masses and recorder of the Masters of Writing, and given overall command of armies at court and in the field.
units.literal: On gengyin day the Prince of Ancheng, Xu, bearer of the staff, minister of works, inspector of Yangzhou, and newly appointed director of the Masters of Writing, was made Bearer of the Staff, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, advanced to grand mentor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and area commander over all armies within and without.

units.zh: 二年春正月己亥，侍中、都督中外諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史安成王頊進位太傅，領司徒，加殊禮，闰履上殿；
units.en: On jihai day in the first month of year 2 Xu, Prince of Ancheng—palace attendant, commander of all armies, grand general of agile cavalry, minister over the masses, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and inspector of Yangzhou—was promoted to grand tutor, retained the post of minister over the masses, received extraordinary honors, and was allowed to wear shoes in the audience hall;
units.literal: On jihai day of the first month, spring, in year two, the Prince of Ancheng, Xu, Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander over all armies within and without, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Mentor, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Inspector of Yangzhou, was advanced to Grand Tutor, retained the post of grand mentor, was granted extraordinary honors, and wore shoes in the hall;

units.zh: 五月景辰，太傅安成王頊獻玉璽一。
units.en: On jingchen day of the fifth month Grand Tutor Xu, Prince of Ancheng, presented a jade seal.
units.literal: On jingchen day of the fifth month, Grand Tutor Xu, Prince of Ancheng, presented one jade seal.

units.zh: 太傅安成王固天生德，齊聖廣深，二后鍾心，三靈佇眷。
units.en: Grand Tutor Xu, Prince of Ancheng, is virtuous by nature, sage and far-reaching; both empresses trust him, and heaven and earth mark him out.
units.literal: The Grand Tutor, Prince of Ancheng, Xu, by nature possesses virtue; sagely and broad, the two empresses set their hearts on him, and the three spirits look to him in hope.

units.zh: 及疾將大漸，召高宗謂曰「吾欲遵太伯之事」，高宗初未達旨，後寤，乃拜伏涕泣，固辭。
units.en: As his illness deepened he called Emperor Xuan and said, "I mean to follow the Duke of Wu's example of yielding the throne." At first Emperor Xuan did not understand; when he did, he prostrated himself, wept, and refused.
units.literal: When his illness was about to reach its crisis, he summoned Emperor Xuan and said, "I wish to follow the affair of Duke Tai," Emperor Xuan at first did not grasp his meaning; afterward he understood, then bowed prostrate, wept, and firmly declined.

units.zh: 〈宣帝紀〉
units.en: 〈Annals of Emperor Xuan〉
units.literal: 〈Annals of Emperor Xuan〉

units.zh: 太傅親承顧託，鎮守宮闈，遺誥綢繆，義深垣屏，而欑塗未御，翌日無淹，仍遣劉師知、殷不佞等顯言排斥。
units.en: The Grand Tutor had been entrusted in person to guard the palace; the late emperor's will bound him like a wall—yet the emperor never came to him on the first day of mourning, and on the very next day sent Liu Shizhi, Yin Buxin, and others to push him aside.
units.literal: The Grand Tutor personally received the entrustment and guarded the palace gates; the late emperor's testament was close-woven in meaning, deep as a rampart wall—yet the ceremonial road was not yet driven, and not even a day passed before he still sent Liu Shizhi, Yin Buxin, and others to speak openly of driving him out.

units.zh: 文皇知子之鑒，事甚帝堯，傳弟之懷，又符太伯。
units.en: Emperor Wen knew which son could bear the charge, as Yao did; his wish to pass the throne to his younger brother matched the Duke of Wu.
units.literal: The Literary Emperor knew his son's measure, a matter like Emperor Yao's; his wish to pass the throne to his younger brother also matched Duke Tai of Wu.

units.zh: 高祖武皇帝撥亂反正，膺圖御籙，重懸三象，還補二儀；
units.en: The Founder put rebellion down and righted the realm, took the mandate and ruled by the tally, restored heaven's lights, and repaired earth's order;
units.literal: The Founder, Martial Emperor, put down disorder and restored the right, received the chart and held the tally, rehung the three luminaries, and mended the two principles;

units.zh: 盪主侯法喜等，太傅麾下，恆遊府朝，啗以深利，謀興肘腋。
units.en: The steward Hou Faxi and others, who served in the Grand Tutor's household and frequented the court, were bought with heavy bribes to strike at close range.
units.literal: The steward Hou Faxi and others, under the Grand Tutor's command, constantly moved in and out of the princely mansion; fed with deep profit, they plotted trouble at the armpit.

units.zh: 四年，陳寶應與留異連結，又遣兵隨周迪更出臨川，世祖遣信義太守余孝頃自海道襲晉安，文季為之前軍，所向克捷。
units.en: In the fourth year Chen Baoying allied with Liu Yi and sent troops with Zhou Di against Linchuan again. Emperor Wen sent Yu Xiaoqing, administrator of Xinyi, by sea against Jin'an with Wenji as vanguard. Everywhere they went they prevailed.
units.literal: In the fourth year Chen Baoying joined with Liu Yi; he also sent troops with Zhou Di to come out again at Linchuan; Emperor Wen sent the Administrator of Xinyi, Yu Xiaoqing, by the sea route to strike Jin'an; Wenji served as his vanguard; wherever he went he won.

units.zh: 陳寶應平，文季戰功居多，還，轉府諮議參軍，領中直兵。
units.en: When Baoying was suppressed Wenji's battle merit stood first. On return he was made advisory military adjutant of the staff, still commanding the central straight guard.
units.literal: When Chen Baoying was pacified Wenji's battle merit was greatest; on return he was transferred to advisory military adjutant of the establishment, concurrently commanding the central straight guard.

units.zh: 及西魏寇江陵，元帝徵湘州刺史宜豐侯蕭循入援，以勱監湘州。
units.en: When Western Wei attacked Jiangling, Emperor Yuan summoned Xiao Xun, Marquis of Yifeng and inspector of Xiangzhou, to reinforce him; Mo was left to oversee the province.
units.literal: When Western Wei raided Jiangling, Emperor Yuan summoned the Inspector of Xiangzhou, Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun, to aid; Mo was left to oversee Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 後主沈皇后 張貴妃
units.en: Last Emperor Empress Shen; Noble Consort Zhang
units.literal: Last Emperor Empress Shen; Noble Consort Zhang

units.zh: 世祖性恭儉，而嬪嬙多闕，高宗、後主內職無所改作。
units.en: Emperor Wen was respectful and frugal, and many concubines' posts still went unfilled; Emperor Xuan and the Last Emperor changed nothing in the inner offices.
units.literal: Emperor Wen was by nature respectful and frugal, yet many concubines' posts still stood vacant; Emperor Xuan and the Last Emperor made no changes to the inner offices.

units.zh: 承聖二年，后生後主於江陵。
units.en: In Chengsheng year 2 (553), the empress gave birth to the Last Emperor at Jiangling.
units.literal: In Chengsheng year 2, the empress gave birth to the Last Emperor at Jiangling.

units.zh: [6]後主即位，立為皇后。
units.en: [6] When the Last Emperor came to the throne, she was made empress.
units.literal: [6] When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, she was established as empress.

units.zh: 太建三年納為皇太子妃。
units.en: In Taijian year 3 (571), she was taken as the crown prince's consort.
units.literal: In Taijian year 3, she was taken in as the crown prince's consort.

units.zh: 後主即位，拜為貴妃。
units.en: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, she was appointed noble consort.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, she was appointed noble consort.

units.zh: 是時龔貴嬪為良娣，貴妃年十歲，為之給使，後主見而說焉，因得幸，遂有娠，生太子深。
units.en: At the time Honored Consort Gong was liangdi, and the noble consort, then ten, served her. The Last Emperor saw and liked her, so she gained his favor, became pregnant, and gave birth to Crown Prince Shen.
units.literal: At this time Honored Consort Gong was liangdi, and the noble consort, aged ten, served her; the Last Emperor saw her and liked her, so she gained favor, became pregnant, and gave birth to Crown Prince Shen.

units.zh: 明年，江陵陷，高宗遷于關右，后與後主俱留穰城。
units.en: The next year Jiangling fell and Emperor Xuan was moved west of the passes, while the empress and the Last Emperor remained at Rangcheng.
units.literal: The next year Jiangling fell, and Emperor Xuan was moved to the lands west of the passes; the empress and the Last Emperor both remained at Rangcheng.

units.zh: 天嘉二年，與後主還朝，后為安成王妃。
units.en: In Tianjia year 2 (561), she returned to court with the Last Emperor and became Princess of Ancheng.
units.literal: In Tianjia year 2, she and the Last Emperor returned to court, and the empress became Princess of Ancheng.

units.zh: 高宗崩，始興王叔陵為亂，後主賴后與樂安君吳氏救而獲免，事在叔陵傳。
units.en: When Emperor Xuan died, Prince Shuling of Shixing rebelled. The Last Emperor escaped only because the empress and Lady Wu of Le'an rescued him; the affair is told in Shuling's biography.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan died, Prince Shuling of Shixing made disorder; the Last Emperor escaped only through rescue by the empress and Lady Wu of Le'an. The affair is in Shuling's biography.

units.zh: 後主即位，尊后為皇太后，宮曰弘範。
units.en: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, he honored the empress as empress dowager; her palace was called Hongfan.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, he honored the empress as empress dowager, and her palace was called Hongfan.

units.zh: 當是之時，新失淮南之地，隋師臨江，又國遭大喪，後主病瘡不能聽政，其誅叔陵、供大行喪事、邊境防守及百司红務，雖假以後主之命，實皆決之於后。
units.en: At the time Huainan had just been lost, Sui forces were on the Yangzi, and the state was in mourning. The Last Emperor was ill with sores and could not hear government, so the execution of Shuling, the late emperor's funeral, frontier defense, and all the business of the offices were formally done in the Last Emperor's name but in fact decided by the empress.
units.literal: At this time the Huainan lands had newly been lost, the Sui army stood on the Yangzi, and the state had suffered a great mourning; the Last Emperor was ill with sores and could not hear government, so the execution of Shuling, the funeral affairs for the deceased ruler, frontier defenses, and the many offices of government, though carried out in the Last Emperor's name, were all in fact decided by the empress.

units.zh: 後主瘡愈，乃歸政焉。
units.en: When the Last Emperor recovered, she returned the government to him.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor recovered from his sores, she then returned government to him.

units.zh: 後主即位，以帝舅加散騎常侍。
units.en: When the Last Emperor succeeded, as the emperor's uncle by marriage he was made scattered-cavalry regular attendant.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor took the throne, as the emperor's maternal uncle he was promoted to scattered-cavalry regular attendant.

units.zh: 後主即位，稍遷至散騎常侍、纫尉卿。
units.en: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, Zhuang gradually rose to scattered-cavalry regular attendant and minister of the guards.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, he was gradually promoted to scattered-cavalry regular attendant and minister of the guards.

units.zh: 後主皇后沈婺華
units.en: Last Emperor Empress Shen Wuhua
units.literal: Last Emperor Empress Shen Wuhua

units.zh: 後主沈皇后諱婺華，儀同三司望蔡貞憲侯君理女也。
units.en: Empress Shen of the Last Emperor, personal name Wuhua, was the daughter of Junli, Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Marquis Zhenxian of Wangcai.
units.literal: Empress Shen of the Last Emperor, personal name Wuhua, was the daughter of Junli, Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Marquis Zhenxian of Wangcai.

units.zh: 初，後主在東宮，而后父君理卒，后居憂，處於別殿，哀毀逾禮。
units.en: Earlier, while the Last Emperor was still in the Eastern Palace, the empress's father Junli died. She observed mourning in a separate hall and wasted herself with grief beyond the rites.
units.literal: Earlier, while the Last Emperor was in the Eastern Palace, the empress's father Junli died; the empress observed mourning and stayed in a separate hall, wasting herself with grief beyond the rites.

units.zh: 後主遇后既薄，而張貴妃寵傾後宮，後宮之政嵭歸之，后澹然未嘗有所忌怨。
units.en: The Last Emperor treated the empress coldly, while Noble Consort Zhang dominated the harem in favor and all inner-palace affairs passed to her. The empress remained calm and never showed jealousy or resentment.
units.literal: The Last Emperor treated the empress coldly, while Noble Consort Zhang's favor dominated the rear palace and all inner-palace government went to her; the empress remained calm and never showed jealousy or resentment.

units.zh: 陳亡，與後主俱入長安。
units.en: When Chen fell, she was taken to Chang'an with the Last Emperor.
units.literal: When Chen fell, she and the Last Emperor both entered Chang'an.

units.zh: 及後主薨，后自為哀辭，文甚酸切。
units.en: When the Last Emperor died, the empress herself composed a lament, deeply sorrowful in its wording.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor died, the empress herself composed a lament, and the writing was deeply sorrowful.

units.zh: 禎明中，與蕭瓛、蕭巖率红叛隋歸朝，後主擢為太子詹事。
units.en: In the Zhenming era he and Xiao Kan and Xiao Yan led their men in defecting from Sui back to Chen; the Last Emperor made him grand mentor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: In the Zhenming era, together with Xiao Kan and Xiao Yan he led their followers in defecting from Sui and returning to court; the Last Emperor promoted him to grand mentor of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 君公博學有才辯，善談論，後主深器之。
units.en: Jun Gong was learned, eloquent, and skilled in debate; the Last Emperor prized him highly.
units.literal: Jun Gong was broadly learned, talented in debate, and skilled at discussion; the Last Emperor valued him deeply.

units.zh: 後主貴妃張麗華
units.en: Last Emperor Noble Consort Zhang Lihua
units.literal: Last Emperor Noble Consort Zhang Lihua

units.zh: 後主張貴妃名麗華，兵家女也。
units.en: Noble Consort Zhang of the Last Emperor, named Lihua, was the daughter of a military household.
units.literal: Noble Consort Zhang of the Last Emperor, named Lihua, was the daughter of a military household.

units.zh: 後主為太子，以選入宮。
units.en: When the Last Emperor was crown prince, she was selected to enter the palace.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor was crown prince, she was selected to enter the palace.

units.zh: 後主每引貴妃與賓客遊宴，貴妃薦諸宮女預焉，後宮等咸德之，競言貴妃之善，由是愛傾後宮。
units.en: Whenever the Last Emperor brought the noble consort to feasts with guests, she recommended other palace women to take part. The women of the harem were all grateful and competed to praise her goodness, so affection throughout the harem turned toward her.
units.literal: Whenever the Last Emperor brought the noble consort to roam and feast with guests, she recommended palace women to take part; the women of the rear palace were all grateful and vied in speaking of the noble consort's goodness, so affection in the rear palace leaned wholly to her.

units.zh: 又好厭魅之術，假鬼道以惑後主，置淫祀於宮中，聚諸妖巫使之鼓舞，因參訪外事，人閒有一言一事，妃必先知之，以白後主，由是益重妃，內外宗族，多被引用。
units.en: She also delighted in spells and enchantment, using ghostly arts to delude the Last Emperor. She set up illicit sacrifices in the palace, gathered shamans and witches to drum and dance, and used them to inquire into outside affairs. Whenever some word or event arose among the people, the consort always knew it first and reported it to the Last Emperor. Because of this he valued her still more, and many of her relatives inside and outside the palace were brought into office.
units.literal: She also liked arts of spells and enchantment, borrowed ghost ways to delude the Last Emperor, set up illicit sacrifices in the palace, gathered shamans and witches and had them drum and dance, and through them investigated outside affairs; if among the people there was a word or an event, the consort always knew it first and reported it to the Last Emperor. Because of this he valued her still more, and many of her kin inside and outside were brought into office.

units.zh: 及隋軍陷臺城，妃與後主俱入于井，隋軍出之，晉王廣命斬貴妃，牓於青溪中橋。
units.en: When the Sui army took Taicheng, the consort and the Last Emperor hid together in a well. Sui soldiers brought them out, and Guang, Prince of Jin, ordered the noble consort beheaded and displayed at the middle bridge over Qingxi.
units.literal: When the Sui army took Taicheng, the consort and the Last Emperor both entered a well; Sui soldiers brought them out, and Guang, Prince of Jin, ordered the noble consort beheaded and displayed at the middle bridge over Qingxi.

units.zh: 史臣侍中鄭國公魏徵考覽記書，參詳故老，云後主初即位，以始興王叔陵之亂，被傷臥于承香閣下，時諸姬嵭不得進，唯張貴妃侍焉。
units.en: The historiographer, palace attendant and Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng, examined the records and consulted elders and wrote: When the Last Emperor first succeeded, he was wounded in the disorder of Prince of Shixing Shuling and lay ill below the Hall of Accepting Fragrance; none of the palace women could enter—only Noble Consort Zhang attended him.
units.literal: The historiographer, Palace Attendant and Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng, examined records and consulted elders, saying: When the Last Emperor first took the throne, because of the disorder of Prince of Shixing Shuling, he was wounded and lay ill below the Hall of Accepting Fragrance; at that time none of the ladies could enter—only Noble Consort Zhang attended him.

units.zh: 後主自居臨春閣，張貴妃居結綺閣，龔、孔二貴嬪居望仙閣，嵭復道交相往來。
units.en: The Last Emperor lived in the Linchun Pavilion, Precious Consort Zhang in the Jieqi Pavilion, and Honored Consorts Gong and Kong in the Wangxian Pavilion, with skyways connecting them for constant visits.
units.literal: The Last Emperor himself dwelt in the Linchun Pavilion; Precious Consort Zhang in the Jieqi Pavilion; the two honored consorts Gong and Kong in the Wangxian Pavilion; elevated passageways linked them so they could come and go to one another.

units.zh: 後主每引賓客對貴妃等遊宴，則使諸貴人及女學士與狎客共賦新詩，互相贈答，採其尤豔麗者以為曲詞，被以新聲，選宮女有容色者以千百數，令習而哥之，[8]分部迭進，持以相樂。
units.en: Whenever the Last Emperor feasted with guests and the Precious Consort, he had the ladies and female academicians join familiar companions in new verse, trading lines; the finest were set as lyrics to new music, and hundreds or thousands of comely palace women were drilled to sing them—[8] sections took turns performing for the revel.
units.literal: Whenever the Last Emperor led guests to feast with the Precious Consort and the others, he would have the various ladies and female academicians join intimates in composing new poems and exchanging verses; the most gorgeous were chosen for song lyrics, set to new tunes; palace women of pleasing looks were selected by the hundreds and thousands and made to study and sing them; [8] by sections they advanced in rotation, holding revel together.

units.zh: 是時，後主怠於政事，百司啟奏，嵭因宦者蔡脫兒、李善度進請，[9]後主置張貴妃於膝上共決之。
units.en: The Last Emperor had grown slack in rule; memorials from every office came only through eunuchs Cai Tuo'er and Li Shandu—[9] and he set Precious Consort Zhang on his knee to decide them with him.
units.literal: At that time the Last Emperor neglected government; when the hundred offices submitted memorials they all reached him through the eunuchs Cai Tuo'er and Li Shandu; [9] he seated Precious Consort Zhang on his lap to decide them together.

units.zh: 琳故吏梁驃騎府倉曹參軍朱瑒致書陳尚書僕射徐陵求琳首曰：
units.en: Zhu Yang, a former clerk of Lin's in the Liang Cavalry-General's Office, wrote to Xu Ling, vice director of the Chen secretariat, begging for Lin's head. He said:
units.literal: Lin's former clerk Zhu Yang, warehouse aide of the Liang Cavalry-General's Office, wrote to Chen Secretariat Vice Director Xu Ling asking for Lin's head, saying:

units.zh: 又陳武帝率衆將攻廣陵，刺史王敬寶遣使告急；
units.en: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;
units.literal: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; Governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;

units.zh: 霸先等智小謀大，政令未一，外託同德，內有離心，諸君不足憂，吾揣之熟悉矣。」
units.en: Chen Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly."
units.literal: Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly."

units.zh: 謂諸將士曰：「吳人輕躁，本無大謀，今破超達，霸先必走。」
units.en: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Chen Baxian will surely flee."
units.literal: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Baxian will surely flee."

units.zh: 陳武帝果遁去。
units.en: Chen Baxian indeed fled.
units.literal: Chen Baxian indeed fled.

units.zh: 五年二月，詔徵韶討之。
units.en: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.
units.literal: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.

units.zh: 韶謂諸將曰：「自梁氏喪亂，國無定主，人懷去就，強者從之。
units.en: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.
units.literal: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.

units.zh: 即回赴廣陵。
units.en: He at once turned back toward Guangling.
units.literal: He at once turned back toward Guangling.

units.zh: 又別队歐陽紇等攻逼衡州，嶺表紛紜，殊淹弦望。
units.en: Another column under Ouyang He and others besieged Hengzhou; the south of the mountains was in turmoil for many months.
units.literal: Moreover a separate column under Ouyang He and others pressed Hengzhou; south of the ranges all was turmoil, and the months dragged on.

units.zh: 賾與河南元善、河東柳䛒、太原王劭、吳興姚察、琅琊諸葛潁、信都劉焯、河間劉炫相善，每因休假，清談竟日。
units.en: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.
units.literal: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.

units.zh: 梁元帝謂其僕射王褒曰：「我未嘗有意用陸為三公，而自稱何也？」
units.en: Emperor Yuan of Liang said to his vice director Wang Bao, "I never meant to use Lu as one of the Three Dukes—why does he style himself so?"
units.literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang said to his vice director Wang Bao: "I never meant to use Lu as one of the Three Dukes—why does he style himself so?"

units.zh: 褒曰：「彼旣以道術自命，容是先知。」
units.en: Bao said, "He has made himself master of occult arts—perhaps he foreknows."
units.literal: Bao said: "He has made himself master of occult arts—perhaps he foreknows."

units.zh: 未拜，為御史中丞宗元饒所劾，免官，以王還第。
units.en: Before he took office the censor-in-chief Zong Yuanrao impeached him; he was dismissed and sent back to his princely residence.
units.literal: Before he took up the post, he was impeached by the censor-in-chief Zong Yuanrao, removed from office, and sent to his princely residence as a prince only.

units.zh: 六年，授持節、都督豫章郡諸軍事、豫章內史。
units.en: In year six he received the staff and was made commander of armies in Yuzhang and interior magistrate of the commandery.
units.literal: In year six he was given the staff and made Area Commander over Military Affairs in Yuzhang commandery and Interior Magistrate of Yuzhang.

units.zh: 父之遴，荊州治中從事史。
units.en: His father Zhi-lin was an aide in the secretariat of Jing province.
units.literal: His father Zhi-lin was Aide in the Secretariat of Jing province.

units.zh: 祖虯，齊世以國子博士徵，不就。
units.en: His grandfather Qiu, in Qi times, was summoned as erudite of the national university and declined.
units.literal: His grandfather Qiu in Qi times was summoned as Erudite of the National University and did not accept.

units.zh: 仲威從弟廣德，亦好學，負才任氣。
units.en: Zhongwei's younger cousin Guangde also loved learning and was confident in his talent and spirit.
units.literal: Zhongwei's younger cousin Guangde also loved learning and relied on his talent and spirit.

units.zh: 鎮東將軍、東揚州刺史始興王伯茂進號征東將軍、開府儀同三司；
units.en: Bomao, Prince of Shixing, garrisoning east general and inspector of East Yangzhou, was promoted to general who campaigns east with a mansion equal to the three dukes;
units.literal: Garrisoning East General and Inspector of East Yangzhou, the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns East and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes;

units.zh: 癸丑，以征東將軍、開府儀同三司、東揚州刺史始興王伯茂為中纫大將軍，[7]開府儀同三司黃法矴為鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史鄱陽王伯山為鎮東將軍、東揚州刺史。
units.en: On guichou day Bomao, Prince of Shixing, general who campaigns east, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of East Yangzhou, was made central army general; Huang Faqu was made general who garrisons the north and inspector of South Xuzhou; Boshan, Prince of Poyang, was shifted to general who garrisons the east and inspector of East Yangzhou.
units.literal: On guichou day the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, General Who Campaigns East, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou, was made Central Army General; Huang Faqu was made General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou; the Prince of Poyang, Boshan, General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou, was made General Who Garrisons the East and Inspector of East Yangzhou.

units.zh: 以征東將軍開府儀同三司東揚州刺史始興王伯茂為中纫大將軍 「征東將軍」
units.en: On "Prince of Shixing Bomao, general who campaigns east, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, inspector of East Yangzhou, made central army general"—note on general who campaigns east:
units.literal: the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, General Who Campaigns East, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou, was made Central Army General—"General Who Campaigns East"

units.zh: 及卒，尚書令江總為其志銘，後主又題銘後四十字，遣左民尚書蔡徵宣敕就宅鐫之。
units.en: When he died, Secretariat Director Jiang Zong wrote his epitaph. The Last Emperor added forty characters of his own and sent Left Household Minister Cai Zheng with an edict to carve them at Yang's house.
units.literal: When he died, Secretariat Director Jiang Zong composed his funerary inscription; the Last Emperor also inscribed forty characters after the inscription and sent Left Household Minister Cai Zheng with an edict to his residence to carve it.

units.zh: 禎明元年卒官，時年七十二。
units.en: In the first year of Zhenming (587) he died in office, aged seventy-two.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhenming he died in office, aged seventy-two.

units.zh: 永定元年，使於齊，以陳郡袁憲為副，齊以王琳之故，執而囚之。
units.en: In Yongding year 1 he was sent as envoy to Qi, with Yuan Xian of Chen commandery as deputy. Because of Wang Lin, Qi seized and imprisoned them.
units.literal: In Yongding year 1, he was sent as envoy to Qi, with Yuan Xian of Chen commandery as deputy; because of Wang Lin, Qi seized and imprisoned them.

units.zh: 瑜及憲並危殆者數矣，齊僕射楊遵彥憫其無辜，每救護之。
units.en: Yu and Xian were in mortal danger several times, but Yang Zunyan, vice director in Qi, pitied their innocence and repeatedly protected them.
units.literal: Yu and Xian were both in mortal danger several times, but the Qi vice director Yang Zunyan pitied their innocence and rescued and protected them each time.
